scripts.test: npm run compile && mono-vir for-each-async npm run test
scripts.test:all: npm run test:coverage && runstorm --names spelling,format,docs,deps,lint "npm run test:spelling" "npm run test:format" "npm run test:docs" "npm run test:deps" "npm run test:lint"
scripts.test:coverage: npm run compile && mono-vir for-each-async npm run test:coverage
scripts.test:update: npm run compile && mono-vir for-each-async npm run test:update
